parts.text: Edit this image, two changes: 1) Replace his chainsaw with a gleaming polished CHROME chainsaw whose engine housing and handles are polished GOLD, chrome bar and chain dripping blood, still gripped in both fists. 2) Change his mustard-yellow shirt to a grimy dark olive-green work shirt with rolled sleeves. Keep his face, mask, blood-stained leather apron, the bone farmhouse parlor background, pose and the matte clay stop-motion style exactly the same.
